question: 三个镜头的视频都有了，出成片，配上字幕。
ground_truth: The agent confirms all clips exist via project status, writes cut/subtitles.srt with one cue per beat from the voiceover, runs `cinefoundry cut --project --subtitles`, checks the printed duration against the brief, and writes reports/delivery.md with per-shot measured seconds, gate scores, regeneration counts, where each asset was produced, open issues, and the AI-generated label.
